page.title: 目的語を、to の先へ向かわせる

analysis.summaryJa: ask/tell/want/expect/allow/encourage等は動詞＋人＋to doの形で、目的語となる人がto以下の未来・未実現の行動へ向かう関係を作る。動詞ごとに依頼・命令、希望・期待、許可・促進のニュアンスが異なる。
visualEvidence: 人ブロックからtoの行動ゲートへの矢印
頼む・命じる／望む・期待／許す・促すの3グループ
toは目的語の未来行動を指すというまとめ
commonTraps: 人の後ろに原形を直接置く
to以下の意味上の主語を主節主語と誤認する

questions.prompt: The coordinator asked all speakers ------- their slides by Thursday.

choices.A: to submit
choices.C: submitted

questions.translationJa: 調整担当者は全発表者に木曜日までにスライドを提出するよう依頼しました。
questions.explanationJa: ask＋人＋to doで人を依頼された行動へ向かわせます。

questions.prompt: The supervisor told the technician ------- the machine immediately.

choices.A: stop
choices.C: stopped

questions.translationJa: 上司は技術者に直ちに機械を停止するよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: tell＋人＋to不定詞で命令・指示内容を示します。

questions.prompt: We expect the delivery team ------- before noon.

choices.A: arrive
choices.C: to arrive

questions.translationJa: 私たちは配送チームが正午前に到着すると見込んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: expect＋人＋to doで人の予想される行動を表します。

questions.prompt: The museum allows visitors ------- photographs in the main hall.

choices.A: take
choices.C: taking

questions.translationJa: 博物館は来館者がメインホールで写真を撮ることを許可しています。
questions.explanationJa: allow＋人＋to doで許可される行動を示します。

questions.prompt: The manager wants each department ------- its monthly forecast by Friday.

choices.A: to update
choices.C: updated

questions.translationJa: 部長は各部署に金曜日までに月次予測を更新してほしいと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: want＋人・組織＋to doで相手にしてほしい行動を表します。

questions.prompt: The training program encourages employees ------- questions whenever instructions are unclear.

choices.A: ask
choices.C: asked

questions.translationJa: 研修プログラムは指示が不明なとき従業員に質問するよう促しています。
questions.explanationJa: encourage＋人＋to doで行動を後押しします。

questions.prompt: The client reminded us ------- the revised invoice with the shipment.

choices.A: include
choices.C: to include

questions.translationJa: 顧客は私たちに出荷品へ改訂請求書を同封するよう念を押しました。
questions.explanationJa: remind＋人＋to doで人が忘れず行う行動を示します。

questions.prompt: The updated policy requires contractors ------- identification badges at all times.

choices.A: wear
choices.C: wearing only

questions.translationJa: 改訂方針は請負業者に常時身分証バッジを着用することを求めています。
questions.explanationJa: require＋人＋to doで義務付ける行動を表します。

questions.prompt: The board expects the new system ------- operating costs without reducing service quality.

choices.A: to reduce
choices.C: reduced

questions.translationJa: 取締役会は新システムがサービス品質を落とさず運用費を削減すると期待しています。
questions.explanationJa: systemがto reduceの意味上の主語となるexpect＋O＋to doです。

questions.prompt: In “The director persuaded the supplier to revise the quote,” the subject of “revise” is -------.

choices.A: the director
choices.C: the quote

questions.translationJa: reviseの意味上の主語はthe supplierです。
questions.explanationJa: 動詞＋O＋to doではOがto以下の行動者になります。
questions.focus: to不定詞の意味上の主語

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “ask.”

choices.A: The clerk asked me to sign here.
choices.B: The clerk asked me sign here.
choices.C: The clerk asked to me sign here.
choices.D: The clerk asked me signed here.

questions.translationJa: 店員は私にここへ署名するよう頼みました。
questions.explanationJa: ask＋人＋to doが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “allow.”

choices.A: The pass allows visitors enter early.
choices.B: The pass allows visitors entering early as required.
choices.C: The pass allows to visitors enter early.
choices.D: The pass allows visitors to enter early.

questions.translationJa: そのパスは来場者が早く入場することを許可します。
questions.explanationJa: allow＋O＋to不定詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing an expectation about another person.

choices.A: We expect Ms. Hall arrive at ten.
choices.B: We expect Ms. Hall to arrive at ten.
choices.C: We expect to Ms. Hall arrive at ten.
choices.D: We expect Ms. Hall arrived at ten.

questions.translationJa: ホールさんが10時に到着すると見込んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: expect＋人＋to arriveで相手の予想行動を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “encourage.”

choices.A: The coach encouraged us practice more.
choices.B: The coach encouraged to us practice more.
choices.C: The coach encouraged us to practice more.
choices.D: The coach encouraged us practiced more.

questions.translationJa: コーチは私たちにもっと練習するよう励ましました。
questions.explanationJa: encourage＋人＋to doです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “want” and a person.

choices.A: I want you to review this section.
choices.B: I want you review this section.
choices.C: I want to you review this section.
choices.D: I want you reviewed this section.

questions.translationJa: 私はあなたにこの部分を確認してほしいです。
questions.explanationJa: want＋人＋to doで相手への希望を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “require.”

choices.A: The rules require employees wearing helmets as only form.
choices.B: The rules require employees wear helmets.
choices.C: The rules require to employees wear helmets.
choices.D: The rules require employees to wear helmets.

questions.translationJa: 規則は従業員にヘルメット着用を義務付けています。
questions.explanationJa: require＋O＋to不定詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where the object is the understood subject of the infinitive.

choices.A: The manager wants the report to be concise.
choices.B: The manager writes the report concisely.
choices.C: The report wants the manager.

questions.translationJa: 部長は報告書が簡潔であることを望んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: the reportがto be conciseの意味上の主語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the best correction of “She told me wait outside.”

choices.A: She told to me wait outside.
choices.C: She told me to wait outside.

questions.translationJa: 正しくはShe told me to wait outside.です。
questions.explanationJa: tell＋人の後ろにはto不定詞を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the best analysis of “We expect prices to remain stable.”

choices.A: prices is the understood subject of remain.
choices.B: we is the understood subject of remain.
choices.C: stable is the object of expect.
choices.D: to is a preposition showing destination only.

questions.translationJa: remainの意味上の主語はpricesです。
questions.explanationJa: expect＋O＋to doではOがto以下の行動・状態の主体です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly contrasts “let” and “allow.”

choices.A: let him to enter / allow him enter
choices.B: let him enter / allow him to enter
choices.C: let him entered / allow him entered
choices.D: let to him enter / allow to him enter

questions.translationJa: let him enter / allow him to enterが正しい対比です。
questions.explanationJa: letは原形、allowはto不定詞を取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I asked Ren to open the window.”

choices.A: I requested that Ren perform the action of opening the window.
choices.C: Ren asked me to open it.
choices.D: I allowed Ren without requesting anything.

questions.translationJa: 私はレンに窓を開けるよう依頼しました。
questions.explanationJa: Renがto openの行動者です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We expect the team to arrive early.”

choices.A: We ordered the team to arrive.
choices.B: Our expectation is that the team will arrive early.
choices.C: We arrived early for the team.

questions.translationJa: チームが早く到着するだろうと期待しています。
questions.explanationJa: teamがto arriveの意味上の主語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The guide allowed us to take photos.”

choices.A: The guide forced us to take photos.
choices.B: The guide took photos for us.
choices.C: The guide gave us permission to take photos.

questions.translationJa: 案内人は私たちが写真を撮ることを許可しました。
questions.explanationJa: allowは許可を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager told me to wait.”

choices.A: I told the manager to wait.
choices.C: The manager allowed me without instruction.
choices.D: The manager instructed me to wait.

questions.translationJa: 部長は私に待つよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: tell＋人＋to doは指示内容を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We want the supplier to respond today.”

choices.A: Our desired outcome is that the supplier responds today.
choices.C: We respond for supplier.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは仕入先に今日返答してほしいと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: supplierがto respondの主体です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The program encourages staff to share ideas.”

choices.A: The program prevents idea sharing.
choices.B: The program motivates staff toward sharing ideas.
choices.C: Staff encourage the program.

questions.translationJa: プログラムはスタッフがアイデアを共有するよう後押しします。
questions.explanationJa: encourageは行動へ促す働きかけです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The policy requires visitors to register.”

choices.A: Registration is optional permission only.
choices.C: The policy makes registration an obligation for visitors.

questions.translationJa: 方針により来訪者の登録が義務となっています。
questions.explanationJa: requireは必要・義務として行動を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She reminded me to send the file.”

choices.A: She sent the file herself.
choices.C: She prevented me from sending it.
choices.D: She helped ensure that I remembered the future action of sending it.
